Is this a full JLPT N3 practice test?

No. It tests the vocabulary section only: 20 words from the JLPT N3 list, each with three meanings to choose from. Listening, reading and grammar are not covered, so use it to check the list, not to predict a score.

How are the questions built?

Each question takes one word from the list and borrows two meanings from other words on the same list, so every wrong option is a real JLPT N3 meaning. It is the word round Lock&Learn Japanese plays on your Lock Screen, without the clock.

Is Lock&Learn Japanese free?

Yes. The app is free on iOS: JLPT N5 is free, every other pack opens with a free preview, and another word unlocks daily. Lock&Learn+ is an optional upgrade that opens every pack at once, offered as a yearly plan or a one-time lifetime purchase.
